marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind light becoming northwest 15 knots early Thursday
morning. Scattered showers beginning overnight changing to scattered
flurries Thursday morning. Fog patches dissipating Thursday
morning. Temperatures near zero. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early
Thursday afternoon.<br/>
